name: zaminai
description: Search properties and create evidence-based CMAs with ZaminAI.

interface.longDescription: A business workflow for real estate professionals to search San Diego County property records, inspect listing photos, find comparable homes, and develop evidence-based comparative market analysis (CMA) pricing strategies. ZaminAI uses the connected user's authorized account. Results may be incomplete or inaccurate and are decision-support estimates, not appraisals, legal advice, tax advice, lending advice, or investment advice.
capabilities: Build and revise CMA pricing analyses
